entries.title: Job 17:1
segments: My spirit is broken, my days are ended, the graves [are] ready for me.

entries.title: Job 17:2
segments: [Are] not mockeries with me? Yea, my eye rests on their insults.

entries.title: Job 17:3
segments: Please lay down a pledge for me with Yourself; who [is] he [who] will strike hands with me?

entries.title: Job 17:4
segments: For You have hidden their heart from understanding; therefore You shall not lift [them] up.

entries.title: Job 17:5
segments: He who for a share informs [against] friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

entries.title: Job 17:6
segments: He has made me also a byword of the peoples; and I am one in whose face they spit.

entries.title: Job 17:7
segments: My eye also is dim from grief; and all my members [are] like a shadow.

entries.title: Job 17:8
segments: Upright ones shall be amazed at this, and the innocent shall stir himself up against the ungodly.

entries.title: Job 17:9
segments: The righteous also shall hold [on] his way, and he who has clean hands adds strength.

entries.title: Job 17:10
segments: And now all of them, go back, and please come again; and I shall not find among you a wise man.

entries.title: Job 17:11
segments: My days are past, my purposes [are] broken off, the desires of my heart.

entries.title: Job 17:12
segments: They set night for day; the light [is] near in the face of darkness.

entries.title: Job 17:13
segments: If I wait for the grave [as] my home, I have made my bed in the darkness;

entries.title: Job 17:14
segments: I have said to corruption, You [are] my father; to the worm, My mother and my sister!

entries.title: Job 17:15
segments: And where then [is] my hope? And [as for] my hope, who shall see it?

entries.title: Job 17:16
segments: They shall go down [to] the bars of the pit, when [our] descent together [is] in the dust.
